title: Pablo Exclusive Strawberry Watermelon Nicotine Pouches - 30mg / Pouch
description: Pablo Exclusive Strawberry Watermelon Nicotine Pouches offer a refreshing escape with every use. The juicy sweetness of watermelon is perfectly matched with the ripe, berry notes of strawberry, creating a smooth and delicious flavour profile. Don't let the fruitiness fool you—at 30mg/g, this is a pouch for the experienced user. The slim, all-white design ensures a comfortable fit and discreet usage, delivering a powerful nicotine lift alongside the bright, summery taste. Ideal for those who want a high-strength pouch that remains fresh and palatable. How to Use: 1 Place a pouch between your upper lip and gum for a consistent nicotine release for up to 60min 2 Place the used pouch in the designated top compartment of the pack. 3 Dispose of the pouch. PLEASE DO NOT CHEW OR SWALLOW POUCH Please Note: These nicotine pouches are 30mg of nicotine per pouch.
